detailed_source_bodies.body: L06 summarizes physical spacetime as a superposition of triality-related regional spacetimes and the full-group generalized Yang-Mills action as reducing to gravity plus a three-generation Standard Model action, but explicitly retains a Kretschmann term, second-order fermion action, possible four-fermion interaction and identical bare masses as irregularities.

The discussion states that CKM/PMNS emergence and particle masses remain unclear, that the correct E8 real form/LGC model/triality may require revision, and that the unusual fermion action/extra gravity term or new-particle predictions may prove untenable.

L06 also leaves the mechanism of 'symmetry keeping', the preference for four-dimensional deforming subspaces, and the requirement that bosonic and fermionic superconnection parts occupy complementary Lie-algebra sectors without a natural explanation beyond stated motivations.

L06 explicitly concedes possible mathematical or physical mistakes and treats harmonic-analysis, torsor/identity, loop-quantum-gravity and eternal-de-Sitter ideas as speculative future directions rather than established parts of the model.
